description: This file defines the class InstanceNumsCalculator, which provides methods to compute instance number sets based on various flags and parameters, primarily used within the Cuttlefish project for managing instance configurations.

classes.name: InstanceNumsCalculator
classes.description: A class that calculates sets of instance numbers based on flags, global gflags, and other parameters, with methods to retrieve the calculated sets.

methods.name: FromFlags
methods.description: Sets the instance calculator state based on a vector of string flags; available in lvalue and rvalue reference versions.

methods.name: FromGlobalGflags
methods.description: Initializes the calculator based on global gflags; available in lvalue and rvalue reference versions.

methods.name: BaseInstanceNum
methods.description: Sets the base instance number; available in lvalue and rvalue reference versions.

methods.name: NumInstances
methods.description: Sets the number of instances; available in lvalue and rvalue reference versions.

methods.name: InstanceNums
methods.description: Sets specific instance numbers either from a string or a vector of integers; available in lvalue and rvalue reference versions.

methods.name: CalculateFromFlags
methods.description: Computes the set of instance IDs based solely on flags such as --instance_nums and --base_instance_num.

methods.name: Calculate
methods.description: Computes the set of instance IDs considering flags, environment variables, and defaults.

methods.name: TrySet
methods.description: A private template method to set a field based on a Result value.
